nodes.label: SaaS Production Launch Plan
nodes.rationale: 7-phase plan for converting Reasoner from single-tenant tool to SaaS: (1) User Auth + Multi-Tenancy with Supabase, (2) Usage Quotas + Tier Enforcement, (3) Stripe Billing + Subscriptions, (4) Coupon System, (5) Docker + Deployment with nginx/Caddy, (6) Security Hardening + GDPR, (7) Monitoring with Sentry/Prometheus/Grafana. Estimated 7-8 weeks to MVP.
